description: Sweezy Lifts — the cut plan, the workouts and Vee.

apps.name: Sweezy Lifts
apps.subtitle: Your cut, your lifts, and Vee.
apps.localizedDescription: Track the 11-week cut from 169 to 160: the Push · Pull · Legs · Upper · Lower split with a workout player and rest timer, the meal plan and recipes, daily weigh-ins against the roadmap, photo check-ins with an on-device taper reading, the Journey, optional Apple Watch data, and Vee the dragon cheering you on. Backs up to a folder you choose so a reinstall never loses your progress.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Sweezy Lifts uses the camera for your check-in photos. They stay on your phone.
privacy.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Read steps, sleep, heart rate, HRV, walks and weigh-ins from Apple Health to show them next to your plan.
privacy.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Save your weigh-ins to Apple Health.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Save your check-in photos to your camera roll so they're never lost.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Pick check-in photos from your library. They stay on your phone.
